'''Bolla Thoath''' was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].

==Biography==
Bolla Thoath served as the [[Executive officer/Legends|second-in-command]] of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Whirlwind (Imperial-class)|''Whirlwind'']] under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Blitzer Harrsk]]. He [[Death/Legends|died]] over the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], when the ship suffered an explosion that also heavily injured its captain. A piece of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] stabbed through Harrsk's left eye and his left frontal lobe, causing two personalities to develop. One was an irrational and megalomaniacal version of his former self; the other personality was Thoath. Throughout the rest of his life, Harrsk would suffer from [[multiple personality disorder]], alternating between the Harrsk and Thoath personas.

[[12 ABY/Legends|Eight years]] after Endor, Harrsk barely survived [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]]'s poison gas attack at the meeting on the [[Tsoss Beacon/Legends|Tsoss Beacon]]. The Thoath persona decided to end Harrsk's irrational campaign and plunged his [[TIE/sh VIP shuttle|TIE shuttle]] into an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]. Harrsk finally realized Thoath had been dead all along, but was too late to stop the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] from crashing, killing him.
